name: The preliminaries of breath-control (place, time, diet, purification)

definitions.definition: Before breath-control the Gheraṇḍa requires, in order, a suitable place (a secluded hut in a good land, not a far country, forest, capital or crowd), the right time (beginning in spring or autumn, not in the cold, hot or rainy seasons), moderate diet, and the purification of the channels (by seed-syllables or by dhauti); only then prāṇāyāma.

relations.note: Preliminaries of prāṇāyāma, the fifth of the Gheraṇḍa's seven means.

name: The eighteen vital points (aṣṭādaśa marmasthāna) of withdrawal

definitions.definition: Eighteen points of the body, from the big toes upward to the head, with fixed distances between them, through which the breath and attention are drawn and held one after another as a form of sense-withdrawal (Yoga Yājñavalkya; Vasiṣṭha Saṃhitā).
The same eighteen points in the Triśikhibrāhmaṇa, Darśana and Śāṇḍilya Upaniṣads, the fifth of their five withdrawals.

notes: The list of the eighteen points and their distances is not entered as members because the unit could not verify it; check the Yoga Yājñavalkya (ch. 7) and the Triśikhibrāhmaṇa.
